answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Hardware attestation: each identity binds to one chip at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 660 identities costs 660 real chips plus the registration bond. The quote is fresh each cycle, so a stolen quote goes stale fast. What carries the inlet here is verification, the copper of cost is what stops the farm, and the reef of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is the whole defence: make the fake cost more than the real.
